title: Government underfunding meant no helicopter for UAP events

tellings.quote: part of our disappointment in the government consisted of insufficient financing when we received funds for these measures.

plain: Between 2020 and 2025, Skywatcher, a company that says it can call up UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), held government-funded events in the western United States to observe them, but the money was too little to pay for a helicopter. The Skywatcher team, including a member named Jake Barber, tells Michels this firsthand, saying "part of our disappointment in the government consisted of insufficient financing." If true, it would mean the government paid for these sightings efforts, but not enough to do them properly.
